description_compelling: Two or more sovereign states exchange sustained military force across a recognized border — air strikes, ground formations, naval engagements. Sovereignty indices, physical-violence indices, and battle-death trajectories all spike. Rarer than civil war in absolute terms but heavily concentrated in disputed-border regions and rival-power flashpoints.

trajectory_alignment.method: z-aggregated across the emitted positive cases (count in samples_used), aligned by lead-year, gaps linearly interpolated. Pre-§F walks emit head(5) positives; §F-onward emit the full corpus.
